name: radio-group
title: Radio Group
description: One of a few, all in view: round marks in a hairline, the picked one edged in White with a White dot. Arrows move the pick.
use_for: A pick of one from two to five choices that each need a word of explanation: who can see a board, how often to send a digest.
never: More than five options: use Native Select or Select
Views of one thing: use Tabs
A spectrum color for the picked mark
source: Derived from the brand guidelines (no radio in the brand assets): White for the picked state, the neutral steps for the hairline, the circle of the logomark's lens
